title: African American Museum

services.name: Purchase Tickets
services.desc: Secure your tickets to the APEX Museum and step into the rich, powerful history of the African and African American experience. Located in the heart of the Sweet Auburn District, our exhibits invite you to explore centuries of resilience, innovation, culture, and community. Whether you’re visiting solo, bringing family, or planning a group experience, your ticket opens the door to stories that inform, inspire, and empower. IMPORTANT: APEX Museum no longer accepts GroupOn or any other third-party ticketing platform. Only tickets purchased from APEX's official website or at the APEX Museum will be accepted. services.name: School Field Trips
services.desc: The APEX Museum is a powerful learning environment for students of all ages. Our field trips connect classroom learning to real stories, real artifacts, and real history - helping students understand the African and African American experience in meaningful, age‑appropriate ways. We recommend one chaperone for every 10 students. Teachers and chaperones are considered general admission, however bus drivers receive complimentary admission. Field trips must be booked in advance.
